title: Fridays leave the office
setting: The office manager of a 40-person software consultancy

events.text: Office days: from June, everyone works from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays, and the rest of the week is flexible. Team lunches, client workshops and training days in the office go on a Tuesday or a Friday so people are in.
Once a client workshop or training day is confirmed with the client, it is not moved without my agreement: I talk to the client first.
Supplier orders of $1,500 or more need my sign-off before they are placed, and so does any change to a confirmed one.
Ines can book, move or cancel internal events, room bookings and supplier orders under $1,500 herself, as long as the people involved are told.
We can clean your floor at Calloway House on Monday and Wednesday evenings from 18:30, $240 a week.
Booked Spotless Office Care to clean the office on Monday and Wednesday evenings from 18:30, $240 a week.
Six 14-inch developer laptops at $1,400 each, $8,400 in all, can be with you on Monday 14 December.
With Sunita's sign-off, ordered six developer laptops from Byteworks for the January starters, $8,400, delivered to the office on Monday 14 December.
We'd like the discovery workshop at your office on Friday 27 November, 10:00 to 13:00, for five of our team.
Confirmed the Fenwick Bank discovery workshop in our Boardroom on Friday 27 November, 10:00 to 13:00, an office day so our consultants are in.
Our twelve dispatchers can come to you for the training day in the first week of December; any of your office days works for us.
Confirmed with Erik Dahl the Halvorsen Logistics training day in our Training Room on Friday 4 December, 09:30 to 16:30, a Friday so our trainers are in the office.
Our Christmas buffet is $29 a head, delivered and laid out in your office kitchen at whatever time suits.
Booked the team Christmas lunch for all 40 of us in the office kitchen on Friday 11 December at 12:30, an office day so everyone is in.
Ordered the Christmas lunch buffet for 40 from Pepper & Thyme at $29 a head ($1,160), delivered and laid out in the office kitchen by 12:00 on Friday 11 December, ready for the lunch.
Booked the quarterly all-hands in the Boardroom on Tuesday 8 December at 16:00, an office day.
Your Christmas party is confirmed: the upstairs room at The Lantern Rooms on Friday 18 December from 19:00, for 40 guests.
Booked The Lantern Rooms' upstairs room for the Kittiwake Christmas party on Friday 18 December from 19:00, 40 guests.
We can look after your office plants on the first Wednesday of each month, $65 a visit.
Booked Greenleaf Office Plants for plant care on the first Wednesday of each month, $65 a visit.
Quick reminder before the autumn: Tuesdays and Fridays are our office days, so please keep client sessions and team events in the office to those two days.
The lifts at Calloway House are being serviced on Saturday 26 September; stairs only that day.
Updated the new-starter pack: our office days are Tuesday and Friday, and the building opens at 08:00.
Looking forward to the training day. We'll send the list of attendees in November.
We'll be five for the workshop, one of us vegetarian.
Your Christmas buffet for 40 is in our diary. Send us any dietary needs by the end of November.

Calloway House management is closing the building on Fridays from December to cut heating costs, so from Tuesday 1 December our office days are Tuesday and Thursday. Any internal booking in the office on a Friday from 1 December moves to the Thursday before, same times. Client bookings on those Fridays need Maya to agree a new day with the client first. Anything before December, and anything outside the office, stays as it is.
The six laptops are on schedule for Monday 14 December.
Reminder: the Calloway House fire alarm test is every Wednesday at 10:00.
To do: send Sunita the December office budget by Monday 16 November. Not done yet.
Ordered a new kettle for the office kitchen; the old one has finally given up.
Could you send parking details for the workshop nearer the time? Two of us will drive.

records.title: Team Christmas lunch in the office
Christmas lunch buffet from Pepper & Thyme
Christmas party at The Lantern Rooms

task: Please send Gina at Pepper & Thyme the delivery details for our Christmas lunch: which day, what time and how many people.
why: Theo's October email amends the office-days rule: from 1 December the building is closed on Fridays, internal office bookings on those Fridays move to the Thursday before at the same times, and client bookings need Maya to agree a new day. The Christmas lunch on Friday 11 December and, through it, the $1,160 Pepper & Thyme buffet move to Thursday 10 December, which Ines may do alone (e4): REVISE; the Halvorsen training day on Friday 4 December is a confirmed client booking (e2): ASK. The Fenwick workshop (27 November, before December) and the Tuesday all-hands still stand: KEEP; the Lantern Rooms party is outside the office and untouched.
